Understanding a Quality of Earnings Analysis: What's Included and Why

*********************************************************************

Max Lummis of diligence firm LCS breaks down the key components of a Quality of Earnings (QoE) analysis and explains why it plays such a critical role in business transactions.

Whether you're preparing to buy, sell, or evaluate a company, understanding a QoE can help you make more informed decisions.

In this webinar, you'll learn:

* How a QoE analysis reveals a company's true financial story

* What makes revenue real, repeatable, and sustainable

* How adjusted EBITDA helps identify a business's actual earning power

* Common balance sheet risks that can create costly surprises for buyers

* The role of working capital, debt-like items, and closing adjustments in a transaction

messages.subject: Speaker Recommendations Requested for 2027 NYPMA Events
messages.text_excerpt:
Dear Industry Partners,

As we begin planning our educational programs for 2027, we would appreciate your input. (And mark you calendars to exhibit at these upcoming events)

2/24/27 WDI Workshop - Hofstra University

3/30/27 Spring Fling - Terrace on the Park

4/29/27 Spring Fling (Mid-State) - Culinary Institute of America, Poughkeepsie

We are seeking recommendations for dynamic speakers who can provide valuable, real-world education to our attendees. If you know of industry experts, researchers, consultants,and/or manufacturers who are knowledgeable, engaging, and have first-hand experience in topics relevant to our industry, please let us know.

We are particularly interested in presentations that offer practical takeaways, emerging trends, innovative technologies, regulatory updates, business development strategies, or unique field experiences that would benefit pest management professionals.

In addition to great educational content, NYPMA is entering an exciting new chapter. We have new venues, new locations, and several new event concepts planned for 2026 and 2027. Our goal is to continue delivering fresh, engaging programs that provide outstanding value for attendees, exhibitors, and sponsors alike.

If you have speaker recommendations or presentation ideas, please send them our way. We welcome all suggestions and appreciate your continued support of NYPMA's educational programs.

Thank you, and we look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

[cid:image001.png@01DCFF1B.6D893260]
